lead: A session that died leaves its whole slice on disk, and the next pack hands you the item as if nothing had been done.
body: A session that exits without a commit and without `.loop/status.txt` leaves `orient.py` quoting the same handoff to the next one, whose item is the unverified work already in the tree; the tell is a `.loop/log.md` session line with `(no status written)`. `git status --short` **before the first edit** — then the owed work is `verify.py`, the commit messages, and the next slice, not a second implementation.
